tasks.title: Nmap NFS Scripts
tasks.description: Enumerate exported shares, their access lists, and NFS statd/mountd details.

tasks.title: List Exports (showmount)
tasks.description: List every share the NFS server is exporting and which hosts/networks are allowed to mount them.

tasks.title: Mount an Export Locally
tasks.description: Mount a discovered share to browse it like a local directory. NFSv3 often has no authentication at all -- access is controlled purely by client IP and UID/GID matching.

tasks.title: UID/GID Spoofing for File Access
tasks.description: NFS permissions map by numeric UID/GID, not username. If a file is owned by a UID that doesn't exist on your Kali box, create a matching local user to read/write it as that 'owner'.

tasks.title: SUID Binary Drop (no_root_squash)
tasks.description: If an export is configured with no_root_squash (check via showmount/exports output), files you create as root on Kali keep root ownership on the target. Drop a SUID shell locally, then execute it from the target to get an instant root shell.
